items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: And, uh, Bunk used to work for them when I was working there.

ctx.x: Barmystrow. Uh, I have a picture of that old house. It was a nice house.

That was the Della Luce old house. Is that right on that main street or is it back a block from, uh... It's right across from Weeks Hall, about three or four houses. Towards New Iberia. I mean towards New Orleans. Yeah, right on Main Street. Main Street. Uh-huh. And, uh, Bunk used to work for them when I was working there. He worked there a while. Uh-huh.
That was in pretty late years, wasn't it?
